sections.name: search_bar
sections.description: Large central search input labelled 'Search the NHS website' with example placeholder text like 'tonsillitis', 'find a GP', or 'paracetamol'.

sections.name: services_grid
sections.description: Three-column card grid linking to 'Find a GP', 'Find a pharmacy' and 'Book or manage an appointment' each with a brief one-line description and a blue chevron link.

sections.name: 111_status
sections.description: Live service status panel for NHS 111 online showing wait time (e.g. 'Average wait: 4 minutes') and a green 'Get help from 111 online' button.

sections.name: nhs_app_promo
sections.description: Dark blue banner promoting the NHS App with bullet features like 'Order repeat prescriptions', 'View your GP health record' and 'Book appointments', plus App Store and Google Play badges.

sections.name: top_topics
sections.description: Carousel of top health topics: 'Coronavirus (COVID-19)', 'Get your flu jab', 'Monkeypox', 'Strep A in children', 'Cost of living and your health'.

sections.name: health_az_link
sections.description: Full-width blue panel linking to the Health A to Z with examples like 'Asthma', 'Back pain', 'Chickenpox'.

sections.name: emergency_callout
sections.description: Persistent red-bordered emergency box reminding users to call 999 for life-threatening emergencies or 111 for urgent non-emergency help.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Health A to Z
sections.subheadline: Conditions, symptoms and treatments, including what to do and when to get help

sections.name: alphabet_index
sections.description: Horizontal A-Z letter selector linking to anchor sections, with disabled state for letters with no entries (e.g. X).

sections.name: breadcrumbs
sections.description: Breadcrumb trail: Home > Health A to Z > Type 2 diabetes.

sections.name: on_this_page
sections.description: Sidebar 'Contents' list linking to: Overview, Symptoms, Causes, Getting diagnosed, Treatment, Living with Type 2 diabetes.

sections.name: overview
sections.description: Short overview paragraph about Type 2 diabetes followed by a blue info box defining HbA1c and blood glucose.

sections.name: symptoms
sections.description: Bullet list of common symptoms such as 'peeing more than usual, especially at night', 'feeling thirsty all the time', 'feeling very tired'.

sections.name: urgent_advice_box
sections.description: Yellow 'Urgent advice: Contact 111 if' callout listing red-flag signs like very high blood sugar readings or symptoms of DKA.

sections.name: treatment
sections.description: Treatment section describing lifestyle changes, metformin medication and referral to the NHS Diabetes Prevention Programme.

sections.name: living_with
sections.description: Numbered steps for daily management including diet, exercise targets (150 minutes/week) and annual diabetic eye screening.

sections.name: last_reviewed

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Find NHS services
sections.subheadline: Search for GPs, dentists, pharmacies, hospitals and more in your area

sections.name: service_type_tabs
sections.description: Row of tabs to select service type: GP, Dentist, Pharmacy, Hospital, Optician, Sexual health clinic, Mental health support.

sections.name: postcode_widget
sections.description: Postcode input with example 'e.g. SW1A 1AA', radius dropdown (1, 3, 5, 10 miles) and a green 'Search' button.

sections.name: results_list
sections.description: List of service result cards each showing name (e.g. 'Riverside Medical Practice'), distance ('0.4 miles'), opening hours, accepting new patients status and a 'Book online' CTA.

sections.name: map_panel
sections.description: Static map placeholder on the right showing pinned results with a note that postcode data is provided by Ordnance Survey.

sections.name: help_choosing
sections.description: Blue info box titled 'Not sure which service you need?' linking to 'Use NHS 111 online' and 'When to call 999'.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Amoxicillin
sections.subheadline: Antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections

sections.name: on_this_page
sections.description: Contents sidebar linking to: About amoxicillin, Who can take it, How and when to take it, Side effects, Pregnancy and breastfeeding, Common questions.

sections.name: key_facts
sections.description: Blue 'Key facts' box with bullets like 'Take amoxicillin at evenly spaced times', 'Common side effects include feeling sick and diarrhoea', 'Finish the full course even if you feel better'.

sections.name: dosage_steps
sections.description: Numbered step-by-step dosage instructions for adults and children including '1. Swallow capsules whole with a drink of water' and '2. Space doses evenly — every 8 hours'.

sections.name: warning_box
sections.description: Yellow warning box covering allergic reactions and instructions to call 999 if signs of anaphylaxis (swollen lips, difficulty breathing) appear.

sections.name: side_effects
sections.description: Bulleted list of common side effects (feeling sick, diarrhoea, thrush) followed by a 'Serious side effects' subsection.

sections.name: interactions_table
sections.description: Two-column table listing medicines that interact with amoxicillin (e.g. methotrexate, warfarin, the contraceptive pill) and the effect.

sections.name: last_reviewed
sections.description: Footer line 'Page last reviewed: 28 November 2022'.

sections.name: conditions_grid

sections.name: self_referral
sections.description: Green 'Get help' panel explaining NHS Talking Therapies (IAPT) self-referral with a postcode lookup to find a local service.

sections.name: young_people
sections.description: Section for under-18s linking to YoungMinds, Kooth and CAMHS referral information.

sections.name: carers_support
